jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Company Description
Yolex Labs is an intelligence ecosystem that embeds forward-deployed engineers within client organizations to solve real problems rather than simply delivering dashboards. The company builds two core products: Candoor, which runs short, anonymous, AI-led voice interviews to surface issues people would not share in traditional surveys, and Storm, which simulates real roles to create live capability maps of what team members can actually do. These tools help organizations understand readiness for AI, identify internal mobility opportunities, and restructure by aligning people with meaningful work. Yolex Labs collaborates with researchers from Boston University, Indiana University, and IIT Kanpur, and is currently in beta with a select group of customers, including Fortune 500 companies.

Role Description
As a Junior Software Engineer at Yolex Labs, you will contribute to the design, development, and maintenance of software components that power products like Candoor and Storm. You will write clean, testable code, participate in code reviews, and collaborate with senior engineers to implement backend services, APIs, and integrations. Daily work includes debugging issues, improving performance, and supporting deployment and monitoring of features in production environments. You will work closely with product and research teams to translate requirements into technical solutions and iterate based on feedback. This is a full-time, on-site role based in the Greater Bengaluru Area.

Qualifications

Strong foundation in Computer Science concepts, including data structures, algorithms, and system design basics.
Proficiency in Programming and Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), with experience in at least one modern language (e.g., Python, Java, C++, or similar).
Hands-on exposure to Software Development practices such as version control (Git), testing, debugging, and continuous integration.
Experience or coursework in Back-End Web Development, including APIs, databases, and server-side frameworks.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
Ability to learn quickly, work collaboratively in cross-functional teams, and communicate clearly in spoken and written English.
Familiarity with cloud platforms, basic security practices, or AI/ML concepts is a plus.

jobs.title: Sr Software Engineer - UI
jobs.description:
Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide.

Living our values everyday results in our team-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves.

Role Overview

We're looking for a talented Frontend Engineer who leads with UI but isn't afraid to go deep. You thrive in a fast moving environment, ship polished interfaces with TypeScript and React and embrace AI-assisted development as a core part of your workflow. This role is front-end-first, but the expectation is that you'll grow into full stack ownership over time.

How You Contribute

Design and build responsive, performant UIs using React, TanStack, Zustand, TypeScript and/or JavaScript
Collaborate on feature development end-to-end, gradually taking on backend work as you grow
Use GitLab for version control, CI/CD pipelines, merge request workflows, and issue tracking
Deploy and manage workloads on Google Cloud Platform CDN, working alongside with services like GKE, and Cloud Storage
Leverage AI-assisted (vibe coding) tools to accelerate development — you're comfortable using Copilot, Cursor, Claude, or similar tools as a force multiplier
Write clean, maintainable code with strong typing and component reuse in mind
Partner closely with designers and product to translate specs into real, shippable experiences
Participate in code reviews, retrospectives, and architectural discussions

Required Skills And Qualifications

5+ years of + post-internship experience with React and TypeScript.
Solid JavaScript/ TypeScript, HTML, CSS
Knowledge of UI Component Libraries, Web Accessibility, Internationalization
Ability to work with test libraries (Jest, Playwright)
Proficient in React, TanStack, Zustand
Engineering focus
Overall system knowledge
Working knowledge of Jira, GitLab, Visual Studio, CI/CD
Proficient in Google Cloud Platform, Kubernetes, BigQuery, Cloud SQL, CDN
Ability to use Claude Code

Desirable Qualifications

AI Tools
Micro Front End Architecture
Java/ Springboot
Database SQL/ NoSQL
